dashboard_item.raw_yaml:
title: Detect suspicious cmd.exe spawning net.exe for domain discovery
id: 08b9e2a6-5d3f-4e2b-8c9a-7f8b4d5c3e2f
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of 'net view /domain' by 'cmd.exe' which is indicative
  of domain discovery.
references:
- https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1135/
- https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/003/
author: SigmaGen
date: '2026-10-27'
tags:
- attack.t1135
- attack.t1059.003
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection:
    CommandLine|contains: net view /domain
    ParentImage|endswith: \cmd.exe
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
- Legitimate administrative script execution
level: medium
dashboard_item.wazuh_xml:
<group name="ml_generated,sysmon,">
  <rule id="100130" level="8">
    <if_group>sysmon_event1</if_group>
    <field name="win.eventdata.commandLine" type="pcre2">(?i)net\ view\ /domain</field>
    <field name="win.eventdata.parentImage" type="pcre2">(?i)\\+cmd\.exe$</field>
    <description>Detect suspicious cmd.exe spawning net.exe for domain discovery [Alert: AI-20261012_133559.466-65749d840f0b]</description>
    <mitre>
      <id>T1135</id>
      <id>T1059.003</id>
    </mitre>
  </rule>
</group>
